description:
Travis Barker’s mom, Gloria, died the day before he started high school. In 2008, the Blink-182 drummer survived a plane crash that killed four people, including two of his closest friends. The only other survivor, friend and collaborator Adam “DJ AM” Goldstein, died less than a year later from an overdose. Travis talks with Anderson Cooper about facing fear and grief after decades of “muscling through” his hurt and how he carries the people he’s lost with him.

For more of “All There Is with Anderson Cooper” visit https://cnn.com/allthereis
title: Blink- 182's Travis Barker on his mom's death and being the sole remaining survivor of a plane crash

author: CNN
description:
The United States is digging itself into an ever-deeper debt hole. 

The federal debt hit a record $40 trillion on Tuesday, according to the Treasury Department. It’s an inauspicious milestone that will have consequences for Americans, businesses and the government for years to come. 

While the nation has long carried a significant amount of debt, there are several recent trends that have budget and financial markets experts even more concerned. 

CNN's Matt Egan explains what it all means. Also, John Berman asks Stef Kight and Margaret Talev from Axios how much of a problem it is for Republicans. And CNN's Kate Bolduan speaks to Rep. Stephen Lynch from the Financial Services Committee about why the US Congress always talks about the national debt but never acts on it. 

0:00 What does the $40 Trillion debt mean to an average American?
4:05 Republicans love to talk about national debt except when in power
8:10 What is Congress' role in tackling the national debt?

Watch 24/7 live new
title: US debt hits $40T. Matt Egan has the price per American

Daryn Dupree testified that Davis admitted to his involvement during an interview with law enforcement that was originally focused on the murder of Christopher Wallace, also known as The Notorious B.I.G.
